events.title: The annunciation
events.line: The angel Gabriel tells Mary in Nazareth that she will bear a son named Jesus.

events.title: Born in Bethlehem
events.line: Jesus is born in Bethlehem and laid in a feeding trough.

events.title: Shepherds hear the news
events.line: An angel announces the birth to shepherds nearby, who go and find the child.

events.title: Presented in the temple
events.line: Mary and Joseph present the infant Jesus in the temple, where Simeon blesses him.

events.title: Visit of the magi
events.line: Wise men from the east follow a star to Bethlehem and offer the child gifts.

events.title: Flight to Egypt
events.line: Warned in a dream, Joseph takes the family to Egypt until Herod dies, then settles in Nazareth.

events.title: The boy in the temple
events.line: At twelve, Jesus stays behind in Jerusalem and is found in the temple among the teachers.

events.title: Baptized in the Jordan
events.line: John baptizes Jesus in the Jordan River, and a voice from heaven calls him the beloved Son.

events.title: Tempted in the wilderness
events.line: Jesus fasts forty days in the wilderness and answers each temptation with Scripture.

events.title: Water into wine at Cana
events.line: At a wedding in Cana, Jesus turns water into wine, his first recorded sign.

events.title: The Samaritan woman
events.line: On the way north, Jesus speaks with a Samaritan woman at Jacob's well and tells her he is the Messiah.

events.title: Rejected at Nazareth
events.line: Jesus reads Isaiah in the Nazareth synagogue, and the town drives him out.

events.title: Ministry base at Capernaum
events.line: Jesus settles in Capernaum, teaching in the synagogue and healing many.

events.title: Calling the fishermen
events.line: After a great catch of fish, Peter, Andrew, James, and John leave their nets to follow Jesus.

events.title: Sermon on the Mount
events.line: On a mountainside Jesus teaches the crowds, beginning with the Beatitudes.

events.title: Calming the storm
events.line: Jesus stills a storm on the Sea of Galilee with a word.

events.title: The Gerasene demoniac
events.line: In the country of the Gerasenes, Jesus frees a man possessed by a legion of demons.

events.title: Feeding the five thousand
events.line: Near Bethsaida, Jesus feeds about five thousand men with five loaves and two fish.

events.title: Walking on the water
events.line: Jesus walks across the Sea of Galilee to the disciples' boat in the night.

events.title: The Syrophoenician woman
events.line: In the region of Tyre and Sidon, Jesus heals the daughter of a Gentile woman who asks in faith.

events.title: Peter's confession
events.line: At Caesarea Philippi, Peter declares that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the living God.

events.title: The transfiguration
events.line: On a high mountain, Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John, with Moses and Elijah appearing.

events.title: Setting out for Jerusalem
events.line: Jesus resolutely sets his face to go to Jerusalem, traveling and teaching along the way.

events.title: Raising of Lazarus
events.line: At Bethany, Jesus calls Lazarus out of the tomb four days after his death.

events.title: Healing blind Bartimaeus
events.line: Near Jericho, Jesus restores the sight of a blind beggar who calls him Son of David.

events.title: Zacchaeus the tax collector
events.line: In Jericho, Jesus stays at the house of Zacchaeus, who repays those he wronged.

events.title: Anointed at Bethany
events.line: At Bethany, Mary anoints Jesus with costly ointment ahead of his burial.

orderingNote.note: John 12:1 dates this six days before the Passover; Mark 14:1 introduces it two days before. The accounts agree on the place, the ointment, and the objection, and differ on when in the week it happened.

events.title: Triumphal entry
events.line: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey as crowds spread branches and shout Hosanna.

events.title: Cleansing the temple
events.line: Jesus drives the money changers and merchants out of the temple courts.

orderingNote.note: John places this at a Passover near the start of the ministry (John 2:13-22); Matthew, Mark, and Luke place it in the final week. The wording is close enough that the accounts describe the same scene, so readers differ over whether the temple was cleared twice or one event has been placed differently. The map follows the Synoptic position and says so.

events.title: The Last Supper
events.line: At a Passover meal, Jesus gives the disciples bread and the cup as his body and blood.

events.title: Gethsemane
events.line: Jesus prays in the garden of Gethsemane and is arrested there after Judas betrays him.

events.title: Trials before the rulers
events.line: Jesus is tried by the council, then sent to Pilate and Herod.

events.title: The crucifixion
events.line: Jesus is crucified at the place called The Skull, between two criminals, and dies.

events.title: Buried in the tomb
events.line: Joseph of Arimathea lays the body of Jesus in a new tomb cut from rock.

events.title: Risen from the dead
events.line: On the first day of the week, the tomb is found empty and Jesus is announced risen.

events.title: The road to Emmaus
events.line: The risen Jesus walks with two disciples to Emmaus and is recognized in the breaking of bread.

events.title: Appearing to Thomas
events.line: Jesus appears to the disciples in Jerusalem, and a week later shows Thomas his hands and side.

events.title: Breakfast by the sea
events.line: The risen Jesus meets seven disciples fishing on the Sea of Galilee and eats with them.

events.title: The great commission
events.line: On a mountain in Galilee, Jesus sends the disciples to make disciples of all nations.

events.title: The ascension
events.line: Near Bethany, Jesus blesses the disciples and is taken up into heaven.
